dedupe_keys.name: san jose park amenities and sports fields

description: This City of San José dataset lists the amenities at every Parks, Recreation and Neighborhood Services site: sports fields, playgrounds by age group, ball courts, amphitheatres and stages, beaches, bike facilities, boat houses and docks, fountains, dog parks, game tables, gardens, outdoor gyms, parcourse stations and monuments. It serves two purposes, helping the public find amenities and helping maintenance staff catalogue and maintain them. Coverage: city parks in San José, California. Access: free on the city open data portal as CSV, shapefile, GeoJSON and an ArcGIS REST layer; the portal record was refreshed on 25 September 2026. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: the inventory is organised for maintenance, so amenity counts and condition fields follow internal practice. Simulation uses are public space asset inventories for heat and flood exposure, park capacity and access analysis, and maintenance planning after events. Related records: OpenStreetMap park features and the Trust for Public Land ParkServe dataset.
